platforms.name: Mesa 24/7
platforms.notes: Most reservation places, each on its own <venue>.mesa247.pe widget or embedded on the restaurant's site (maido.pe, isolina.pe). Free to the diner. Slots are readable per date and party; sold-out shifts sometimes offer a waitlist. Guarantees and prepayment go through Culqi or PayU.

platforms.name: Meitre
platforms.notes: Cosme. Hours readable per service (lunch, dinner) from its public JSON; some shifts carry a per-person no-show fee.

platforms.name: OpenTable
platforms.notes: A few places list it (Sapiens) alongside Mesa 24/7 or WhatsApp.

platforms.name: WhatsApp
platforms.notes: The fallback for almost every place, including those with a widget; staff reply in Spanish, usually within hours.

platforms.name: Walk-in
platforms.notes: Cevicherías, anticucherías, chifas, sangucherías and bars take no bookings; arrive at opening or after the lunch peak.

config.closures: Most fine dining closes Sunday (a few open Sunday lunch only) and several close Monday. Cevicherías serve lunch only, roughly noon to 5 PM; anticucherías open in the late afternoon. Holidays and private events close rooms without notice on the widget.
config.release_norms: Each restaurant sets its own window: Central books up to about four months ahead for parties of 1 to 6; the top tasting rooms fill weeks out and cancellations reappear close to the date. Maido runs a free waitlist per shift that closes at 23:59 the day before.
config.card_notes: Online booking often needs a card guarantee or prepayment, and foreign cards are frequently declined (every US card failed in our run); WhatsApp or email is the way around it. Booking forms ask for a passport or DNI number and time out after about 5 minutes. Some counters are cash only.
config.tipping: About 10% where no service charge is added; some tasting menus include service and tax in the price.
